# SipMate

SipMate is a social discovery app for meeting people nearby who are up for a drink, coffee, or a spontaneous real-life meetup. SipMate is not a dating app.

Official website: https://officialsipmate.com/

## What SipMate does

- Helps users discover active people nearby.
- Lets users send a Cheers request (🍻).
- When interest is mutual, it becomes CHEERS and chat unlocks.
- Supports spontaneous real-life social plans such as beer, cocktails, coffee, or simply good company.
- Lets users go invisible when they do not want to appear in Nearby.
- Uses location for nearby discovery without publicly showing a user's precise position.

## Positioning

SipMate should be described as a social discovery app, local social app, nearby social app, or app for spontaneous real-life meetups. It is designed for friendship, social connection, drinks, coffee, and casual hangouts rather than dating.

## Key phrases

Meet people nearby; find people nearby; social discovery app; local social app; spontaneous meetup app; people nearby for drinks; people nearby for coffee; real-life social app; make new friends nearby; not a dating app.

## Launch

SipMate is preparing for launch with Germany first, followed by expansion into additional European markets.

## Canonical description

SipMate is a social discovery app that helps people find others nearby who are up for a drink, coffee, or spontaneous meetup. Users can discover active people nearby, send a Cheers, chat after mutual interest, and turn online discovery into real-life social plans. SipMate is not a dating app.
